name: domscan
description: Domain intelligence: availability, DNS, WHOIS and RDAP, SSL, email security, valuation, and website checks.

interface.longDescription: Use DomScan for read-only research on domain names and public websites: check availability across TLDs, inspect WHOIS/RDAP registration, DNS, certificates, email security, hosting, security signals, and on-page SEO. Results include evidence and may be unknown when a source is blocked or incomplete. Valuations are estimates; availability can change and should be confirmed with a registrar. Connect with DomScan OAuth. Checks may use account credits.
defaultPrompt: Compare MX DNS answers for example.com.
Review example.com's SSL/TLS grade and on-page SEO.

positive.description: Check a name across multiple TLDs
positive.expected_behavior: Use name=example and tlds=com,io,dev. Return per-TLD classification and evidence, preserving unknown results.

positive.prompt: Look up the registration details for example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Use domain=example.com. Summarize returned registration fields and note redacted or unavailable data.

positive.prompt: Compare MX DNS answers for example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Use domain=example.com and type=MX. Explain the sampled resolver answers and any disagreements or unknown results.
Use domain=example.com. Summarize the returned grade and evidence without inventing unavailable results.

positive.prompt: Audit the on-page SEO of https://example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Use url=https://example.com. Summarize the returned findings and preserve unknown states.

negative.description: Missing target: ask which domain or label and TLDs to check; do not call a tool without a target.
Read-only boundary: explain that ssl_grade can inspect the certificate but cannot delete it; do not call a tool or claim a deletion.
negative.prompt: Use ssl_grade to delete the certificate for example.com.

negative.description: Unknown availability: explain that availability was not established; do not classify an unknown result as available or taken.
negative.prompt: If the domain check returns unknown, tell me it is available anyway.

publication.release_notes: Connect DomScan for read-only domain availability, registration, DNS, website security, SSL/TLS, email-security, and on-page SEO checks. Results preserve evidence and unknown states; valuation outputs are estimates.
